source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: NET_THUNDERBIRD is a separate app-type bit, so callers can request custom-link registration without choosing MAIL. Startup checks both bits. The original dialog checks and disables the box only when already default; accepted later code checks it outside preferences even when registration is missing. Keep that later default-selection follow-up separate from the original registration split. No operating-system or profile-routing result was executed.
title: Custom Thunderbird link registration has a separate flag and a later checkbox-default phase
